fields.Name: T128 - Admin Database Designer
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Data & Schema > Database Designer sub-section renders without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Data & Schema' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'Database Designer' sub-section. The success state is the Database Designer view rendering its expected widgets/controls. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the view to render, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Data & Schema section open and the Database Designer sub-section selected in the left sub-navigation
The Database Designer view renders its expected widgets/controls (or a valid empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
